title: Ramp and drop
done: Up the ramp, across the deck, and drop! Thump, the truck landed.

steps.say: Put a green square flat on the table. The road starts here.
Stand six blue squares in a ring on the table, two long. It is the deck's tower.
Lay a yellow square flat on top of the ring, at the far end.
Lay another yellow square flat on top, next to the first. Now the deck is done.
Lean two red squares up, one on the last, from the road to the deck. The ramp!
Lock the ramp: lean one more square from the side of the tower up under the middle of the ramp. Now it holds a truck.
Past the deck, lay a yellow square flat on the table. The truck lands here!
One more square, flat on the table, next to the last.
One more square, flat on the table, next to the last.
